triples.evidence_text: Take adequate measures to avoid that the motor is started while you are working on the pump. This is especially important for electric motors with remote control: • Switch the operating switch near the pump (if available) to "OFF".

triples.evidence_text: Take adequate measures to avoid that the motor is started while you are working on the pump. Before starting any disassembly the pump should be drained. 1 If necessary, close the valves in the suction and delivery pipe and in the flushing or cooling supply lines to the shaft seal. 2 Remove the drain plug (0310) or cleaning cover (0370).
Assembly and disassembly work requires no special tools. However, such tools can make certain jobs easier, for instance replacing the shaft seal.
